s.n: Iceberg Lounge salmon rye and spiced olives
s.how: Cut 4 slices rye into small squares and spread with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon. Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and a pinch of chilli flakes for 3 minutes, then serve both on a dark board.

Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of sugar and 300ml warm water into a dough and rest an hour. Roll into ropes and shape into question marks. Dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and soften, then pour in 375ml stout and enough water to cover. Add thyme, cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until tender. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.

w.note: the sea wall breaking and flooding Gotham
w.how: Heat 300ml cream until steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 yolks with 50g sugar and stir through until glossy. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with whipped cream and a scatter of crushed honeycomb just before serving.

d.how: Brew 4 shots of espresso, or 160ml very strong coffee, and cool. Chill 4 martini glasses. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur, 40ml coffee and 10ml sugar syrup very hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. For anyone not drinking, shake the coffee with milk, ice and a little vanilla syrup.
